coverage_notes: Exhaustive sweep across 9 products (Hex, Observable, Google Sheets, Databox, Knowi, Basedash, Tictable, Index, Jupyter). For each product, captured official homepages (T0), documentation/API/changelog (T1), G2/Capterra/analyst reports (T2), and third-party teardowns/comparisons (T3). Verified URLs via WebFetch where possible. Notable: "Index" resolves to Anthropic Economic Index (open dataset, not a SaaS), included for completeness but distinct from commercial tools. HCI pain evidence found in review aggregates (G2/Capterra highlight support quality, performance issues, adoption friction). Analyst coverage (Gartner 2026 predictions, a16z investment analysis, Forrester architecture) captures macro trends in AI agents + analytics convergence. Funding data sourced from Crunchbase/PitchBook. Coverage spans products from established (Google Sheets, Jupyter) to growth-stage (Basedash Series A 2023, Hex Series C 2025). DEDUPED: Eliminated unrelated products with similar names (Hexomatic, Knowde, Redux-Observable, etc.). Focused on notebook + AI-native + lightweight data studios as defined in scope.
